sagalassos.name: Sagalassos
sagalassos.slogan: A Roman city on a mountainside, 1,500 metres up in the Taurus.
sagalassos.line: Sagalassos was known in Roman times as the first city of Pisidia, and Belgian teams have dug it since 1990.

pisidiaantiocheia.name: Antioch of Pisidia
pisidiaantiocheia.slogan: Where Paul preached to the synagogue and was run out of town.
pisidiaantiocheia.line: Augustus made it Colonia Caesarea, the only one of eight Pisidian colonies to also receive Italian law rights.

egirdirkalesi.name: Eğirdir Castle
egirdirkalesi.slogan: A fortress that keeps one foot on land and the rest in the lake.
egirdirkalesi.line: An inscription records its restoration in 1307 by Dündar of the Hamidids; Timur partly ruined it in 1402.

golcuktabiatparki.name: Gölcük Crater Lake
golcuktabiatparki.slogan: A volcanic bowl of still water above the rose city.
golcuktabiatparki.line: The lake fills a volcanic crater about 1,380 metres up, only a few kilometres from Isparta, and became a nature park in 1991.

mimarsinanisparta.name: Firdevs Bey Mosque
mimarsinanisparta.slogan: Sinan's name, a governor's gift and a bazaar that paid for both.
mimarsinanisparta.line: Built around 1561 for governor Firdevs Pasha, it is attributed to Sinan, and the bedesten next door funded it.
